_notes: Ion constants for the Water Analysis page (prompt section 4). Keys starting with '_' are documentation only.
_lockedIons: CONFIRMED against Vontron 6.1: the CO3 box is always disabled (checked at pH 7.5, 8.0, 8.3, 8.5, 9.0, 10.0). It is always 0, so the calculation ignores any typed or loaded CO3.

tdsOnlyMode._notes: Specify Individual Solutes unticked: TDS is split into Na and Cl.

rounding._notes: Vontron rounds mg/L to 2 decimals before converting (golden 10.1: Na 786.47 -> ppm 1714.50, not 1714.51). Inferred from the golden data.

balance._imbalanceWarningMeq: CONFIRMED against Vontron 6.1 sweep: warning shows when |balance| > 0.1 meq/L (displayed, 1 decimal): 0.1 no, 0.2 yes, 0.7 yes. NOT percentage based (0.12% at TDS 35000 still warns).
balance._cationExcessIon: CONFIRMED against Vontron 6.1 (cations 10.0 vs anions 7.6, Cl 110 -> 195.20).
balance._correctionMgPerMeq: mg/L added per meq of balance. Vontron uses 35.5 for Cl here (not the 35.45 used for the meq column): 110 + 2.4 x 35.5 = 195.20.
balance._balanceFromRoundedTotals: Vontron shows Balance = round(cations,1) - round(anions,1) (10.0 - 7.6 = 2.4, exact 2.459) and corrects by that value.

validation._notes: CONFIRMED against Vontron 6.1 Water Analysis messages: 'Temperature Limits:0~40 C' and 'Limits of pH:0~14'. Whether the end values are accepted is not tested yet.
